task: Re-route the ~14 git child-process sites that default cwd to metadataRoot/projectRoot so they use the configured gitRoot (authoritativeCwd from the existing resolveStorySignedWorkspace()), with a null/unresolved fallback to projectRoot. Sites: handlers/validate-channel.ts (git reads), handlers/validate-concept.ts (git diff + repo grep), core/cluster-sync.ts (git log main..HEAD), handlers/worktree.ts (story_discard + story_advance merge + remove/branchExists helpers). cwd-only; no command text, gate semantics, or bootstrap change. Add a wrapper-root vs plain-repo test pair.
outcome: In a wrapper-root project (metadataRoot is NOT a git repo; configured gitRoot=<subdir>), `lattice story_discard`, `lattice validate --channel`, and `lattice validate --concept` no longer print 'fatal: not a git repository' — they run git against the resolved gitRoot and succeed, producing the same output as running the identical git commands from inside <subdir>/. In a plain repo (metadataRoot == gitRoot, resolver returns null/unresolved), output and behavior are byte-identical to before (fallback to projectRoot). A new wrapper-root vs plain-repo test pair passes, asserting each rerouted git site runs in the correct cwd.
facts: resolveStorySignedWorkspace() in core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts already computes authoritativeCwd = resolved gitRoot (resolutionSource=configured-git-root) and is used by story_resolve
The defect: ~14 git child-process call sites bypass the resolver and use cwd: projectRoot/root (the metadataRoot)

Confirmed sites: validate-channel.ts default git readers (cwd: projectRoot, lines ~75/79/83/91/98); validate-concept.ts git diff + grep readers; cluster-sync.ts readCommitsSinceMain git log (cwd: projectRoot); handlers/worktree.ts git()/execFileSync call sites for story_discard + story_advance merge + remove/branchExists
The readers use a dependency-injection seam (default readers) that can be threaded with the resolved cwd without changing command text
Bugs 2/3/4 from the ClawCreek report (atomic bootstrap, .lattice track/ignore data-loss, lint change-scope) are out of scope (separate stories)
